Title: Azure DevTest Labs environments are now available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce that Azure DevTest Labs environments are now available in Azure Government. Use this feature to readily deploy your development or test environments with complex infrastructures like Web Apps with databases, Dev SharePoint Farms, or Service Fabric Clusters in a consistent way within the confines of the lab. These environments can contain any Azure resources that Azure Resource Manager templates can create. As a lab admin, you can author and maintain Azure Resource Manager templates in your source control repositories that will be used to create IT-approved custom environments in the lab within minutes.

Learn more about how to create multi-virtual-machine (VM) environments and platform as a service (PaaS) resources with Azure Resource Manager templates in DevTest Labs.

Try it today and let us know what you think. If you have an idea, submit your feedback (or vote for others) at the Azure DevTest Labs feedback forum.

Post feedback on our Azure DevTest Labs Forum
